_note: Competition calendar for the first season (Nov 2026 – Oct 2027). Big meets use real dates from SUL's Arvokilpailukalenteri 2027 (preliminary, 12.5.2026) and kilpailukalenteri.fi. "main": "indoor" / "outdoor" marks the season's main championship of an age class (GDD 4.8): the coach's default target and the anchor of the training phases; where none fits the athlete's age the highest-level coach meet of that season part is used. Entries with "estimated": true are small meets with believable but made-up dates (the real ones aren't published centrally) - correct them freely. Later seasons repeat this list 52 weeks later as estimates. city "@club" = your club's town, "@district" = a meet somewhere in your district. ages = age-class range (age class = competition year - birth year). coach = the club coach suggests it. watch = big event shown for atmosphere, not enterable.

fees._note: Entry fee per event in euros, used later by the money system. Per-meet "fee" = known real fee; these level defaults are estimates.
